test_title: PYST 24: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

She **returned back** to her village after years.
solution:
The correct answer is '**returned**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 

• The word "**returned**" already means "to go back", so using "returned back" is redundant. 

• The correct replacement for the highlighted part is simply "**returned**" without adding "back" to it. 

• **Options 1, 3, and 4** are either redundant or grammatically incorrect in this context. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**. 
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"She **returned**__ to her village after years."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 
 

• **Option 1: "came again"** is not suitable because it does not convey the act of going back to a place. 

• **Option 3: "went back again"** is redundant and unnecessarily repeats the idea of returning. 

• **Option 4: "has returned back"** is both redundant and grammatically incorrect in the context of the sentence.
